Two pointers track two positions and move them according to a condition.
Index Jදෙකක් තියාJගන condition එක අනුව එකක් Jහතෝ Jදෙකම move කරනවා. Sorted pair- sum problem එකකට sum එක අඩු නම් left pointer එක ඉදිරියට යවනවා.
Find two prices that sum to a budget.
pair([1,2,4,7,9],11) is true. O(n) time, O(1) extra space.
Why is sorting important for this approach?
It makes pointer moves eliminate impossible pairs.
